english.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for an exaggeratedly joyful manner.

exampleSentences.english: I was ecstatically happy after getting a present and couldn't sleep all night.
exampleSentences.traditional: 我收到份禮物，開心到癲咁，成晚都瞓唔着。
